title: Online Business Permit and Licensing System
description: Davao City's online system supports new and renewal business permit applications, online payments, and online issuance of approved permits.
notes: The City Government's official Online Services directory lists this system. Portal instructions were checked on 27 October 2026. Other transactions are marked as under development on the portal; application details and fees can change.
feesNote: The portal assesses business tax by application; no single amount is published. Review the portal's assessment before payment.
requirements: New permit: government-issued ID for sole proprietors; business barangay clearance; business location map; DTI certificate and tax-exemption certificate, if applicable; tax declaration/land title or affidavit of undertaking where the premises are not rented; lease contract or affidavit of no rental as applicable; certified employee list; and cedula.
Corporations or CDA entities: SEC or CDA registration and, for corporations, articles of incorporation and bylaws.

Renewal: BIR Form 2551Q quarterly percentage-tax return; financial statement; special power of attorney, secretary's certificate, or board resolution; IDs for owners and authorized representative; certification; Fire Safety Inspection Certificate; previous Mayor's Permit; barangay certification if blocked; and certified employee list.
The portal directs applicants missing the stated renewal documents to their respective district offices.
steps: Select the new or renewal permit route in the online system.
Follow the route-specific instructions and attach the requested documents.
Track the application and follow the current payment and permit-release instructions shown by the portal.

title: PSA Birth Certificate Copy
description: Request a QR-coded PSA copy online, or ask about PSA-copy requests at Davao City Civil Registrar district offices.
onlineServiceNote: This order is handled by PSAHelpline, a third-party provider that describes itself as an authorized PSA online channel. Confirm current eligibility and total charges with the provider; Requisito is not a government service.

feeDetails.description: PSAHelpline online order: provider FAQ says this includes its service fee and nationwide courier fee. This is the provider's listed price, not a PSA-government fee schedule.

PSA copy requested through the CCRO Tugbok District Office: the City reported ₱155 for the PSA copy plus ₱100 service fee, with official receipts. The City report was published 1 March 2023; confirm this older amount before visiting.

feesNote: Prices are for different request channels and come from sources with different dates. Confirm the current total, delivery or pickup, and eligibility before ordering or paying.
requirements: PSAHelpline says the requester must be of legal age and authorized to request the certificate; parents may request a minor child's certificate.
The City report says PSA copies could be requested at the CCRO Tugbok District Office; it does not state the complete eligibility or document checklist.
processingInfo: PSAHelpline FAQ states 3–8 working days for delivery outside Metro Manila after PSA releases the document; exceptional manual verification may add seven working days. Check the provider's current estimate at checkout.
steps: Request the PSA certificate through the online provider.
Pay online or through an available over-the-counter option shown by the provider.
Wait for delivery or check the provider's current pickup options.
notes: PSA.gov.ph could not be reached during this check. The ₱365 amount is from PSAHelpline's own FAQ, which describes itself as an authorized online channel; this was not independently confirmed on PSA.gov.ph. The ₱255 Davao district-office amount is dated 2023 and may be outdated.

title: Davao City Marriage License
description: Apply for a marriage license through the City Civil Registrar's Office. The City's page lists general documents and age- or applicant-specific requirements.

feeDetails.description: Marriage license application fee, payable at the City Treasurer's Office, as listed on the City page (last modified 8 October 2026).
Marriage license fee, payable at the City Treasurer's Office, as listed on the City page (last modified 8 October 2026).
Marriage registration fee listed for foreign-national applicants; confirm that this applies to your case with the City Civil Registrar.

feesNote: The City's listed application and license fees total ₱500 (₱300 + ₱200). It separately lists a ₱250 fee for foreign-national applicants. Confirm the fees and any additional charges with CCRO before payment.
requirements: Both applicants must appear in person.
PSA or locally issued birth certificate and CENOMAR, each one original and two photocopies.
Pre-marriage counseling certificate/certificate of compliance and one supporting record (baptismal certificate, voter's affidavit, or school record/TOR), each one original and two photocopies.

Valid IDs for both applicants, two photocopies each; the City page also specifies a Davao City address. Non-residents must provide barangay certification as proof of residency, one original and two photocopies.
The City page lists cedula for the applying couple and their parents as required before notarization and filing.

Applicants aged 18–20 need notarized parental consent and parent appearance. Parental advice is listed for younger adult applicants, but the page gives inconsistent upper ages (25 in the body and 24 in its checklist); confirm the applicable age threshold with CCRO.
Foreign applicants need a Certificate of Legal Capacity to Marry (one original, five photocopies), passport bio and arrival-stamp pages (two photocopies each), and divorce papers where applicable.
Additional records apply to widowed, annulled, or divorced applicants and to certain parental-consent cases; consult the complete City requirements page.
processingInfo: The City page does not specify processing time.
steps: Review the complete City requirements page for age, residency, foreign-national, and prior-marriage conditions.
Both applicants appear in person and submit the required originals and photocopies.
Pay the applicable listed fees at the City Treasurer's Office.
notes: City source page published 7 February 2019 and last modified 8 October 2026. It is internally inconsistent about the upper age for parental advice (25 in the body, 24 in the checklist); confirm this point with CCRO. Requirements include additional exceptions for age, foreign-national status, and prior marriages; review the full page.
